proposed_concepts.name: Asymmetric Initiation Pattern
proposed_concepts.definition: A relational pattern wherein one partner deliberately refrains from ever initiating text messages, phone calls, or date plans, forcing the other partner to sustain all relational momentum.

proposed_concepts.name: Negging Dynamics
proposed_concepts.definition: A manipulative tactic involving backhanded compliments and deliberate status-undermining remarks designed to erode a partner's self-esteem and create an artificial power imbalance.

proposed_concepts.name: Relational Scarcity Tactics
proposed_concepts.definition: The deliberate manufacturing of perceived competition—such as boasting of external options or past exes—to induce fear of replacement and provoke unilateral over-investment.

proposed_concepts.name: Prolonged Silent Treatment
proposed_concepts.definition: The weaponized withdrawal of verbal contact and refusal to engage in conflict resolution, serving as emotional punishment and control rather than a constructive cooling-off period.

proposed_concepts.name: Manufactured Jealousy
proposed_concepts.definition: The intentional elicitation of jealousy through overt disclosures of outside romantic interest to test a partner's emotional compliance, dependency, and distress.

proposed_relationships.description: Negging and status erosion trigger the over-pursuit loop as the victim scrambles to regain approval.
Relational scarcity tactics activate the anxious attachment system through perceived threat of abandonment.
Prolonged silent treatment induces panic and frantic repair attempts in the anxious partner.
